about: AC6 (docs/specs/S50-grid-tilemap.md): edit_tilemap ops on a 16-tile tileset (ids 0-15, probability 1, no terrains), layer seed 0, on each layout. TilemapBrushTest.McpOpsGiveTheGoldenCells replays them through TilemapBrush and prints the cells when they differ; tools/mcp/tests/test_tilemap_grid.py::test_brush_identity sends them through edit_tilemap and compares get_tilemap's cells. Cells are [x, y, tile, flags] sorted, flags masked to flip x (1<<24), flip y (1<<25) and transpose (1<<26).
